search.profiles: All 184 DPS profiles on the final engine, starting from the migrated and re-optimized setups. Tanks keep their guarded selections.

confirmation.rule: retain if the two-seed mean gain exceeds 1.96 x the summed standard errors

talents.method: Legal one-point reallocations screened at 250 iterations, the five best confirmed at 2,000 iterations on a separate seed; a move is kept above 2.5 combined standard errors; up to four rounds. One representative race per build; the result applies to every race of the build.

rotations.method: Arcane and Arcane-Frost priority variants on Gnome and Human (Undead for one variant) at 3,000 iterations, repeated on a second seed for the leading variants.

selected.arcane: Arcane Blast to 4 stacks (above 20% mana) before Arcane Wrath; Arcane Missiles on Missile Barrage first; Arcane Missiles as the filler.
selected.arcane_frost: Arcane Blast to 4 stacks (above 20% mana) before Frostbolt; Arcane Wrath is not cast.
selected.frost: Unchanged; an Arcane Blast variant with 1/1 Arcane Blast ran out of mana.
